writing.overall_comment: A clean, semantically consistent reference for React development, but it reads more like a knowledge dump than an actionable skill and omits edge cases or failure-path guidance.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name 'frontend-react' and description accurately reflect the React/Next.js/Tailwind/shadcn/ui content, though the promised '复杂状态管理' (complex state management) is only lightly covered.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The two code examples are syntactically correct and idiomatic, but there are no failure paths, error handling, anti-patterns, or edge-case guidance.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The doc reads as a well-organized reference with feature lists and best practices, but lacks explicit step-by-step or executable procedures for building a React app.

suggestions: In the code examples and best-practices sections, add concrete failure-path, error-handling, anti-pattern, and edge-case examples (e.g., API errors and empty states) to address the missing edge-case guidance.
In the main React guide, add an explicit step-by-step executable procedure for building a React app, with commands and expected outcomes, to improve actionability.
